data.title: Religious Affairs President Inaugurates New Digital Services for Prophet’s Mosque Visitors
data.content:
Madinah, November 18, 2026, SPA -- President of Religious Affairs at the Grand Mosque and the Prophet’s Mosque Sheikh Dr. Abdulrahman Al-Sudais today inaugurated a digital religious center and an awareness program at the Prophet’s Mosque to enhance services and outreach, leveraging modern technology to convey the mosque’s message to the world.
    The center focuses on advancing digital transformation, refining the delivery of religious and awareness services, and broadening their reach to enrich the experience of visitors. The program helps foster a better understanding of Islamic legal rulings, establish accurate religious concepts, and offer content that deepens visitors’ knowledge of their faith.
    -- SPA
